cookieConsent.label: Cookie preferences
cookieConsent.message: We use technical cookies required for the site to work and, with your consent, our own statistics cookie (no third parties) and third-party cookies (Meta Pixel, Google Analytics) to understand how the site is used, which visits lead to a purchase and to measure our advertising.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {store} collects when you visit this site or place an order, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it. It applies to this website only.

controller.heading: Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: The data controller is {name}, a sole proprietorship trading as {brand}, registered at {address}. For any question about this policy or about your personal data, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.intro: We collect only what we need to run the shop:
items: Order data — your name, email address, phone number, shipping address and the contents of your order. You provide this at checkout; without it we cannot fulfil an order.
Contact data — the name, email address and message you send us through the contact form or WhatsApp.
Technical data — IP address, browser type, device type and the pages you visit. This is generated automatically by our hosting provider and is used to keep the site running and secure.

Site usage statistics — we record directly, on our database provider's servers, the pages you visit, the products you view or add to the cart, checkout starts, the referring page, any campaign parameters in the link (utm), device type and country. To estimate the number of visitors we use a code derived from the IP address and browser that changes every day: the IP address itself is not stored and nothing is saved on your device. Our hosting provider (Vercel Web Analytics) collects similar statistics, also without cookies.

Statistics identifier and link to orders — only if you accept cookies, our server stores a cookie (kaya_vid) with a random code in your browser. It lets us recognise later visits from the same browser and link any order you place to those visits (for example: where the first visit came from, how many visits and days passed before the purchase, which products you viewed). The cookie contains neither your name nor any other data and is not read or shared by third parties.

Advertising data — if, and only if, you accept cookies, the Meta Pixel records the pages and products you view, items you add to the cart, and completed orders, and sends this to Meta together with an identifier stored in a cookie. Google Analytics records the same events and sends them to Google, also with a cookie identifier.

purposes.heading: Why we use it, and on what legal basis
purposes.intro: Under the GDPR we must have a legal basis for each use of your data:
items: To process, ship and invoice your order — performance of a contract with you (Art. 6(1)(b)).
To answer your messages — performance of a contract, or our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f)).
To keep the site available, secure and free of fraud — our legitimate interest in protecting the business (Art. 6(1)(f)).
To keep accounting and tax records — compliance with a legal obligation under Italian law (Art. 6(1)(c)).
Aggregate, cookieless statistics on how the site is used — our legitimate interest in understanding and improving the shop (Art. 6(1)(f)). The data is not linked to your identity.

Recognising later visits and linking visits to your orders through the kaya_vid cookie, measuring traffic and advertising results, and personalising advertising through the Meta Pixel and Google Analytics — solely your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time from the “Cookie preferences” link at the bottom of every page; if you decline, no data is processed for these purposes.

cookies.heading: Cookies and tracking
cookies.necessary: We use a small number of strictly necessary cookies and similar local storage to keep your cart, your language choice and your cookie decision. These cannot be switched off and do not require consent.
cookies.pixel: With your consent we also load the Meta Pixel, a tracking tool provided by Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. It sets cookies in your browser and sends Meta information about how you use this site, so that we can measure our advertising and show ads to people who have shown interest in our products. Meta may combine this with data it already holds about you. If you decline, the Pixel is never loaded and no data is sent.
cookies.google: With the same consent we load Google Analytics, provided by Google Ireland Ltd. It sets cookies and sends Google information about the pages you visit, the products you view and add to the cart, and completed orders. We use it to understand how the site is used and to measure the results of our Google Ads campaigns, which may use this data to show our ads to people who visited the site. If you decline, Google Analytics is never loaded.
cookies.manage: The banner appears on your first visit and again after 12 months. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time from the “Cookie preferences” link at the bottom of every page: withdrawing deletes the kaya_vid cookie and the Meta and Google cookies in your browser and stops those tools from loading. You can also block cookies entirely in your browser and manage how Meta and Google use your data in the ad settings of your Facebook or Instagram account and your Google account.
cookies.stats: Cookieless statistics. Regardless of your choice we record the visits and on-site actions described above in aggregate form, without storing anything on your device and without saving your IP address; the code used to count visitors changes every day and cannot recognise you over time.
cookies.firstParty: kaya_vid statistics cookie (our own, with consent). If you accept, our server sets the kaya_vid cookie — first-party and not readable by scripts on the page — containing a random code. It expires at the latest 13 months after you accept, and later visits do not extend it. It is used to recognise the same browser returning and to link visits to any order. It is not shared with Meta, Google or any other third party. If you decline or withdraw consent the cookie is deleted immediately and no new data is linked; links already recorded are deleted from our systems 13 months after each visit or order.
cookies.maps: Google Maps. The map on the store page is provided by Google and may set cookies: it loads only if you accepted cookies, or if you choose to show it with its button, which applies to that view only.

sharing.heading: Who we share it with
sharing.intro: We do not sell your data. We share it only with the providers we need to operate the shop, each acting under contract:
items: Our hosting and database providers, who store the site and your order records.
Our email provider, used to send order confirmations and to deliver contact-form messages to us.

Stripe Payments Europe Ltd., for card payments: you enter your card details directly on Stripe's payment page, and they never pass through or are stored on our systems. Stripe receives your email address and the order amount.
WhatsApp Ireland Ltd., only if you choose to order or message us through WhatsApp.
Couriers and shipping partners, who receive the name and address needed to deliver your parcel.
Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. and Google Ireland Ltd., but only if you accepted cookies.
Our accountant and, where the law requires it, the tax authorities.
sharing.transfers: Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where that happens, the transfer is covered by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent safeguard.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
items: Order and invoicing records — 10 years, as required by Italian tax law.
Contact messages — up to 24 months after our last exchange with you.
Technical and server logs — a short period set by our hosting provider, typically a few weeks.
Site usage statistics — 25 months, then deleted.
Link between the kaya_vid cookie, visits and orders — 13 months from each visit or order; the cookie in your browser expires at the latest 13 months after consent.
Your cookie choice — up to 12 months, after which the banner is shown again.
Data held by Meta and Google following your consent — for the periods set out in their own policies, which we do not control.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.intro: You can ask us at any time to:
items: give you a copy of the data we hold about you;
correct anything that is wrong or out of date;
delete your data, where we are not required to keep it;
restrict or object to how we use it;
receive your data in a portable format, or have it sent to another provider;
withdraw your consent to advertising cookies, without affecting what was done before you withdrew it.
rights.howTo: Write to <mail>{email}</mail> and we will respond within one month.
rights.complaint: If you believe we have handled your data improperly, you may lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (garanteprivacy.it), or with the authority in your country of residence.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change how we handle your data we will update this page and the date shown at the top. If the change is significant, we will ask for your consent again where the law requires it.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For any privacy question, or to exercise any of the rights above, contact us at <mail>{email}</mail>.

home.heroTitle: KAYA Studio Outlet — Premium labels, outlet prices

about.lead: KAYA Studio Outlet was born from a simple idea: making designer fashion more accessible.
about.intro: We personally select clothing, footwear and accessories from Italian and international brands, constantly looking for new opportunities, stock and collections on favorable terms.
about.pricesTitle: Why are our prices so affordable?
about.prices1: Our concept is built on sourcing and selecting stock, end-of-line pieces, past-season collections and limited availability, purchased through professional suppliers and trade channels.
about.prices2: This lets us lower the final price and offer our customers original products at outlet prices, often far below the standard retail price.
about.prices3: At KAYA you won’t necessarily find large quantities of the same item: many products are available in just a few pieces, colors or sizes. That is the very heart of our concept.
about.arrivalsTitle: New arrivals, new deals, all the time.
about.arrivals1: Our goal is to choose products with an excellent balance of style, quality and price, offering a selection that changes frequently.
about.concept1: We don’t want to be just a store.
about.concept2: We want to create a place, in store and online, where you discover something new every time and where you can buy designer fashion without necessarily paying full price.
about.tagline: Big brands. Small prices. New deals every time.

terms.title: Terms and conditions of sale
terms.intro: These terms govern purchases made on {site}. By placing an order you confirm that you have read and accepted them. The contract is concluded in Italian; this English version is provided for information.

seller.heading: Seller
seller.body: The seller is {name}, a sole proprietorship trading as {brand}, registered at {address}, VAT number {vat}, entered in the Frosinone-Latina Companies Register, REA {rea}. Email: <mail>{email}</mail> · PEC (certified email): {pec} · Phone: {phone}.

contract.heading: Orders and formation of the contract
contract.body: Products shown on the site are an invitation to make an offer. The contract is formed when we send you the order confirmation email. Our items are often one-offs or in limited supply: if an item you ordered is no longer available, we will tell you promptly and refund anything already paid within 14 days.

prices.heading: Prices
prices.body: Prices are in euro and are final prices, inclusive of all applicable taxes. Shipping costs are shown separately at checkout, before you confirm the order.

payment.heading: Payment
items: Payment card (Visa, Mastercard and the other cards Stripe accepts), through Stripe's secure payment page. The order is confirmed once Stripe tells us the payment has gone through.
Bank transfer: the bank details and payment reference are shown at the end of checkout and in the confirmation email. The order ships once the funds have arrived.
WhatsApp: the order is recorded and the payment details are agreed with you in the chat before shipping.

shipping.heading: Shipping and delivery
shipping.body: Through the website we ship within Italy only; for delivery to other EU countries, contact us on WhatsApp and we will agree costs and times. Standard shipping: €{standardCost}, estimated delivery in {standardDays} business days. Express shipping: €{expressCost}, estimated delivery in {expressDays} business days. Standard shipping is free on orders of €{freeThreshold} or more. Times are estimates and run from dispatch. When your order ships you receive an email with tracking details where available. Risk of loss or damage passes to you on delivery.

withdrawal.heading: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.intro: If you are a consumer, you may withdraw from the contract without giving any reason within 14 days of the day on which you, or a third party you designate, receive the products.
items: To withdraw, send us a clear statement of your decision before the deadline, to <mail>{email}</mail> or to our PEC {pec}, quoting your order number. You may use the form below, but you do not have to.
You must send the products back within 14 days of telling us you are withdrawing, to {address}. You bear the direct cost of returning them.

We will refund all payments received from you, including standard delivery costs, within 14 days of the day we are informed of your withdrawal, using the same payment method you used unless agreed otherwise. We may withhold the refund until we have received the products back or you have supplied proof of having sent them.

Products must be returned intact, unworn and with their original tags. You are liable for any reduction in value resulting from handling beyond what is needed to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.
The right of withdrawal does not apply to sealed goods that are not suitable for return for hygiene reasons (for example underwear and swimwear) once unsealed after delivery.
withdrawal.form: To: {name} ({brand}), {address}, {email}. I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract of sale of the following goods: … — Ordered on / received on: … — Order number: … — Name of consumer: … — Address of consumer: … — Signature (only if this form is sent on paper) — Date: …

warranty.heading: Legal guarantee and authenticity
items: All products are original. If an item turns out not to be authentic, we refund you in full.

As a consumer you benefit from the legal guarantee of conformity under articles 128 et seq. of the Italian Consumer Code: we are liable for any lack of conformity that becomes apparent within two years of delivery. To claim, write to <mail>{email}</mail> describing the defect, ideally within two months of discovering it.

law.heading: Complaints, governing law and jurisdiction
law.body: For any complaint, write to <mail>{email}</mail> and we will reply as soon as possible. The contract is governed by Italian law, without prejudice to the mandatory protections of the law of your country of residence. Disputes with consumers fall under the courts of the consumer's place of residence or domicile. You may also use alternative dispute resolution procedures.

privacy.heading: Personal data
privacy.body: Data you provide with your order is processed as described in our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
